n1.text: Draft 23 Nov 2026 for the owner. One menu look for every program, drawn by the R5 Modern control look (BMenu stays Haiku's). Rounded popup (radius 10 at 12 pt, scales with the font), 5 px inner margin, rows 26 px with a rounded highlight in the accent and white text. Shortcuts right, muted. Colours from ui_color (menu background, selected background = accent). Glass only with the GPU; without effects or in Safe mode the same colours, opaque, no blur. The menu bar's first item next to the round window corner follows the A/B/C choice in the theming session.
